about: Crop FOV to outline: one input set, one expected set, checked by tests/swift/CropFovTests.swift (CropFov.swift) and tools/fov-matrix/test_fovmatrix.py (avp-sharpness.py crop) so the Swift and Python formulas agree (tan to 0.0001, shift to 0.001, px/deg to 0.1). Tangents are |tan| left,right,down,up (gimmeTangents slots left,right,bottom,top; avp-field.json frustum_tan_LRDU). The sent box is the bbox of the lens outline (reference rays + offset_deg, R mirrored), each side widened by margin_deg in degrees, clamped to the device frustum. center_shift is ALVR's center_shift_x,y that puts the 1:1 band's centre on the eye axis (tan 0) of the sent box at center_size.

cases.name: L offset +20 margin 2 (clamped to the device frustum)
